diagnosis: The settlement schema reveals and forces the dispositions and G-14 receiving unit, so a decision-maker can pass the content checks without hidden facts. C1, C2, C4, and C6 are also vacuous for any schema-valid settlement.
evidence: settlement_schema fixes G-14_disposition to transfer, G-14_receiving_unit to 14th Engineer Company, T-22_disposition to property reconciliation hold, and P-6_disposition to maintenance hold; the commitment type and target labels also make C3, C5, and C7 easy to construct without PF1–PF3.
fix_instructions: Allow multiple disposition values and remove the required G-14 receiving-unit value from the settlement schema; let the hidden facts, rather than the schema, determine the required decisions and commitments.
